decisions: Textarea is the actual native textarea export. Native 64px minimum height, 8/10px padding and 10px corners become semantic roles; the 360px sample width does not become a runtime constraint. Source field-sizing-content is represented directly, with a minimum-height fallback and native vertical resizing. Content can grow instead of clipping to a specimen height. Native label/help/error IDs are caller decisions, while readOnly, disabled, multiline value/selection/IME and native events remain browser-owned. Readonly stays focusable and selectable; disabled prevents user edits and is skipped in Tab order. Invalid styling supplements a linked readable error and does not invent validation.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
